dict.string: Face ID is used to unlock Arcfin when App Lock is enabled for your profile.
Arcfin looks for Jellyfin servers and Chromecast devices on your local network so you can connect and cast without typing in an address.

Arcfin uses your Wi-Fi network name to automatically switch between your server's local and remote address when you're home versus away. Your location is never stored, tracked, or shared — it's only used to read the current Wi-Fi name.
